subject: [RFC PATCH v2 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential double-put bug in fuse_try_move_page() and suggested removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely, replacing it with a more robust solution.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Agreed to post a separate series removing ->try_steal and its users, with SPLICE_F_MOVE, SPLICE_F_GIFT, and FUSE_SPLICE_MOVE left as no-ops.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: The patch series proposes changes to the fuse file system, specifically addressing issues related to folio management and page cache interactions. The main goal is to prevent moving a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file, which can lead to double-put bugs. Additionally, there's discussion about removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely and replacing it with a more robust solution.

reviews.author: Linus Torvalds
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion to remove fuse_try_move_folio() and proposed removing pipe_buf_try_steal() as well, considering it's not widely used.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 06:46, David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org> wrote:
>
> Could we get rid of fuse_try_move_folio() entirely?

Please. That would be great.

              Linus
